title: PARALLAX — The future your chat left behind
voiceDirection: Natural English, intimate, warm and moving. Speak to one person, with quiet wonder and thoughtful pauses, without melodrama or imitation of a real person. Let the closing words breathe. Use one consistent selected voice. Preserve exact spoken words; headings and this direction are not narration.

segments.text: A message scrolls away. A choice can stay. What if your chat could leave a world behind?

Here, on EnriEdit's real Twitch chat, it begins with something small. One vote for Aurora. One word: hope. Watch them arrive. These are real messages reaching PARALLAX. When the two futures become one, that choice changes the shared world. One remembered vote. One word carried forward. A small beginning... that the next person will inherit.
Now, a clearly labelled simulation shows the experience with a larger crowd. The streamer opens two possible worlds. Every viewer gets one vote per round.
You do not need to be the loudest person in chat. Choose a branch. Leave a word. The same shared universe responds on the stream overlay.
Reality collapses. One future becomes canon, changing the world's harmony, memory, and visual DNA.
And the future you did not choose? You can still see it. The Butterfly Lens calculates both outcomes from the same beginning, using the same contributions. A way to see what your choice meant.
Step into the unlived future. This is a labelled, read-only preview. It lets the streamer explore a different consequence while the shared world and OBS overlay keep the community's chosen reality.
Someone new arrives. They enter a world already changed by people who came before them. Its memory, harmony, and visual DNA carry forward into the next round.
The latest twelve decisions survive a restart. Revisit their shared origins and compare the two outcomes. The community can see the history behind its world.

OpenAI Codex helped us turn this idea into working software: paired futures, the Butterfly Lens, safer chat handling, and behavioral tests. These are actual build artifacts. This separate local continuation passes twenty-six tests. Codex helped build it. Procedural graphics bring the world to life.
They came to watch. Together... they left a world. PARALLAX. A world that remembers.
